routes.name: Skilled worker residence permit
routes.summary: A residence permit for qualified skilled workers with a job offer related to their qualification. Recognition of your qualification may be required. The language requirement is not stated here because it has not been verified against the official source yet.
eligibility: You have a concrete job offer or an employment contract in Germany
Your qualification is recognised in Germany or is equivalent to a German qualification
You hold a passport valid for your planned stay
You have health insurance cover for Germany
No language level is listed because it has not been verified yet - check the official site

routes.name: Job seeker visa
routes.summary: A visa that lets you look for a qualified job in Germany while staying in the country. Language requirement not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: You hold a qualification that is recognised in Germany
You can show you have enough money for your stay (amount not yet verified)
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have health insurance cover for Germany

routes.name: Student residence permit
routes.summary: A residence permit for a recognised full-time course of study at a German university or college. Language requirement for your course is not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: You have an admission letter from a German higher education institution
You can show you can cover your living costs (amount not yet verified)
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have health insurance cover for Germany
